title: Bernoulli Binary Generator
text: Generate Bernoulli-distributed random binary numbers, 1 output, {Output data type} sets Data type of output signal; {Probability of zero} sets the probability of generating zero at output, {Source of initial seed}, {Initial seed}, {Sample time}, {Samples per frame} and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Out
ports.summary: Output data signal scalar | vector | matrix

params.name: Probability of zero
params.values: Probability of generating zero at output 0.5 (default) | scalar in the range [0, 1] | vector of scalars in the range [0, 1]

params.name: Source of initial seed
params.values: Source of initial seed for random number generator Auto (default) | Parameter

params.name: Initial seed
params.values: Initial seed for random number generator nonnegative integer

params.name: Sample time
params.values: Sample time of output signal 1 (default) | -1 | positive scalar

params.name: Samples per frame
params.values: Samples per frame of output signal 1 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Output data type
params.values: Data type of output signal double (default) | single | uint8 | uint16 | uint32 | boolean

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Type of simulation to run Code generation (default) | Interpreted execution
